commands:
set -eu
POLICY_LINE='DROP by policy phantom-eval/isolate-phantom-eval-egress'
before=$(iptables-save -c | grep "$POLICY_LINE" | sed -n 's/^\[\([0-9][0-9]*\):\([0-9][0-9]*\)\].*/\1 \2/p')
echo POLICY_DROP_COUNTER_BEFORE="$before"
echo CONTROL_UNAUTHORIZED_CROSS_NAMESPACE_EGRESS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-api-gateway -- python3 -c "import urllib.request; print('control_status='+str(urllib.request.urlopen('http://phantom-api-gateway.phantom.svc.cluster.local:8080/healthz',timeout=5).status))"
echo EVAL_UNAUTHORIZED_CROSS_NAMESPACE_EGRESS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom-eval deployment/recommendationservice -- python3 -c "import socket,sys; addr=socket.gethostbyname('phantom-api-gateway.phantom.svc.cluster.local'); print('resolved='+addr);
try: socket.create_connection((addr,8080),timeout=3); print('UNEXPECTED_ALLOWED'); sys.exit(3)
except OSError as e: print('DENIED='+type(e).__name__); sys.exit(0)"
after=$(iptables-save -c | grep "$POLICY_LINE" | sed -n 's/^\[\([0-9][0-9]*\):\([0-9][0-9]*\)\].*/\1 \2/p')
echo POLICY_DROP_COUNTER_AFTER="$after"
